newsitem.title: USA: Montana Power proposes natgas rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Montana Power proposes natgas rate cut.

text.p: Montana Power Co filed a settlement agreement with Montana Public Service Commission to reduce natural gas utility rates by $2.8 million, freeze base rates for two years, and open the door for customer choice, the utility announced Thursday.
When Montana Power made its natural gas restructuring filing last July, it sought a $4.9 million increase to cover higher costs of service.

But the proposal was withdrawn amid legislative efforts to restructure the state's energy utility industries. Under that legislation, Montana customers will be able to choose their gas supplier no later than July 2002.
